description: Buyer codes. entrySecret = HMAC(entryKey, "evenqueue/entry-secret/v1" 0x00 || formNonce)[0:16]; recoveryCode = HMAC(entryKey, "evenqueue/recovery-code/v1" 0x00 || formNonce)[0:10]; viewKey = HMAC(entrySecret, "evenqueue/view-key/v1" 0x00)[0:16]; entrySecretLookup = SHA-256("evenqueue/entry-secret-lookup/v1" 0x00 || entrySecret); viewKeyLookup = SHA-256("evenqueue/view-key-lookup/v1" 0x00 || viewKey); recoveryCodeCheck = HMAC(waitlistKey, "evenqueue/recovery-code-check/v1" 0x00 || recoveryCode); placeTag = SHA-256("evenqueue/place-tag/v1" 0x00 || viewKey). Texts are Crockford base 32 without separators, zero-padded. Computed independently with Python's standard library. The engine and the public verifier must reproduce every case. typedPhrase: seven words from the 7,760-word list, read from HMAC(entryKey, "evenqueue/typed-phrase/v1" 0x00 || formNonce || block number as one byte) for blocks 0, 1, ... as big-endian 16-bit values; a value below 7760 * 8 picks word value mod 7760, others are skipped. typedPhraseCheck = HMAC(waitlistKey, "evenqueue/typed-phrase-check/v1" 0x00 || UTF-8 of the words joined by single spaces).
